info.title: Rahbar API Gateway
info.description:
Production-grade Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) API Gateway for Rahbar.
Built for Coder's Cup '26 Hackathon.
Features: JWT/RBAC, Versioned Rules Engine, Weakest-Link Decision Engine, Consent Gateway, Cryptographic SHA-256 Audit Hash Chain, and Mock DPI Rails with Chaos Mode.

get.description: Returns comprehensive system health status and telemetry.

post.description: Registers a new citizen or user account.

Authenticates user and returns JWT access and refresh tokens.
Pre-seeded Demo Accounts:
- citizen_parveen / password123 (Citizen - Widow)
- citizen_tariq / password123 (Citizen - Shopkeeper)
- helper_shazia / password123 (Community Helper)
- officer_aslam / password123 (Department Officer)
- admin_ayesha / password123 (System Admin)
- auditor_iqbal / password123 (Auditor)
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token.

get.description: Returns profile of currently authenticated user.

post.description:
Creates a new relief grant claim.
Citizens can create for themselves.
Helpers can create for a family IF helper acting consent is given.

get.description:
Lists cases with role-based filtering:
- Citizens: only their own cases.
- Helpers: cases for families they manage.
- Officers/Admins/Auditors: all cases.

schema.title: Response List Cases Api V1 Cases Get

get.description:
Retrieves full case details.
Enforces privacy: if helper views, verifies helper consent; if citizen views, must be owner.

post.description: Attaches a verified or scanned document to the case.
Submits a draft case for evaluation.

Evaluates a case deterministically through the Decision Engine.
- Computes weakest-link confidence = min(identity, ocr, authenticity, rules_complete, scam_safety).
- Checks cost matrix thresholds:
  * Auto-Approve: p_wrong <= 0.05 and rules satisfied
  * Ask More Proof: 0.05 < p_wrong <= 0.30
  * Human Officer Review: p_wrong > 0.30 (The system never auto-rejects!)

get.description:
Returns dual-view explanation:
- view='citizen': Simple Urdu + English explanation with icons for low-literacy users.
- view='auditor': Complete parameter trace, rule version, component confidences, and audit hash.

Returns queue of cases requiring human review.
Sorted by Priority Score (descending) and Confidence (ascending).
Includes full Handoff Packet with case notes and reason flags.

schema.title: Response Get Review Queue Api V1 Review Queue Get

post.description:
Department Officer approves or rejects a claim.
Mandatory audit requirement: Officer MUST provide written notes justifying the decision.
If approved, generates a cryptographic approval token for gated payment release.

get.description: Returns currently active eligibility rule set.
Returns history of all immutable rule versions.

schema.title: Response List Rule Versions Api V1 Rules Versions Get

post.description:
Admin publishes a new rule set.
Becomes active immediately without code changes or server restart.
Citizen grants granular consent for a scope (identity, income, bills, helper_acting).

Citizen withdraws consent for a scope.
Instantly blocks any future read attempts via the Consent Gateway (HTTP 403).

get.description: Displays 'Who Has My Data': lists all granted and revoked scopes for a citizen.

Inspects cryptographic audit trail.
Restricted to Department Officers, Admins, and Auditors.

get.description:
Verifies the SHA-256 cryptographic chain from the genesis block to head.
Proves that no record has been altered, deleted, or backdated.

post.description:
Simulates NADRA Citizen Identity Verification.
Matches CNIC and performs fuzzy name transliteration.
Supports ?chaos=timeout|500|slow.

Simulates SBP Raast Fast Payment Rail.
CRITICAL SECURITY CHECK: Requires a valid cryptographic approval token
generated by the Decision Engine or an Officer review.
Supports idempotency keys to prevent duplicate disbursement.
Simulates Citizen Grievance Redressal / Complaint Portal.

Replays a corpus of historical cases through the draft rule set.
Calculates approval rate deltas, risk shift, and affected case count.
Subscribes an external endpoint to system events.

schema.title: Response List Deliveries Api V1 Webhooks Deliveries Get

post.description:
Detects whether an SMS / WhatsApp message is fraudulent, legitimate, or uncertain.
Provides calibrated confidence and explainable trigger reasons.

Analyzes uploaded document images (CNIC, utility bills).
Performs Laplacian blur detection, Error Level Analysis (ELA) tamper check,
and regex field extraction.
Transcribes spoken Urdu or English audio into text using Groq Whisper-large-v3.

Synthesizes Urdu or English text into natural voice audio (MP3).
Cached by text hash for fast repeated delivery.

Answers relief eligibility and policy questions directly from official guidelines.
Returns plain answer with exact document and page citations.
Converts unstructured conversational Urdu or English input into a validated Pydantic claim form.

Executes the checkpointed LangGraph relief claim workflow.
Evaluates documents, identity, rules, risk, and executes gated payment if approved.

get.description: Telemetry on AI providers (Groq, Gemini) latency and availability.

post.description:
Evaluates a claim using IsolationForest and heuristic rules to detect repeat claims,
helper velocity spikes, and demographic/income statistical anomalies.

get.description:
Returns live threat intelligence feed, regional cluster coordinates,
category distribution, and temporal scam trends across Sindh & Karachi districts.

Returns aggregated evaluation metrics, accuracy scores, confusion matrix,
subsystem latency benchmarks, and threshold sweep expected cost curves.

post.description:
Synchronizes cases queued locally on a helper's phone when connectivity restores.
Provides idempotency deduplication, offline intake extraction, and pipeline routing.
